text:
shiv_procure: FYI vendor just flagged a customs hold in FRA for the A500 batch (12 units). ETA slip ~5 days. this will affect our reserved wave for eu-dedicated. lia_vendor can you share AWB and hold reason?

lia_vendor: AWB 94Z-GBR-FRA-8821. forwarder marked as 'doc mismatch' — missing commercial invoice on their scan. vendor asked carrier to re-upload, ETA 24h to clear docs. sorry about the noise. :disappointed:

marta_ops: @shiv_procure ok — if this drags we need to pull from the contingency loan pool. how many temp units do we have at FRA staging? @warehouse_bot any visibility?

warehouse_bot: Inventory snapshot (last sync 1715006000): FRA staging pool = 4 A500 (standby), 2 L40 spare blades. 2 of the A500s are tagged for on-site evals but could be repurposed with 48h notice.

james_sre: If we repurpose eval units we need to warn the teams using them — they'll see +5% latency under load if we shift capacity. can we shift routing to eu-burst instead?

marta_ops: We can open a controlled redirect: move non-prod traffic to eu-burst for 48-72h, keep prod on reserved but throttle canary jobs. I'll coordinate with platform to update routing policy.

shiv_procure: lia_vendor — if carrier can't resolve doc issue within 24h, can vendor pre-clear and re-ship from DE warehouse? what's the extra lead time and cost? Need fast fallback numbers to commit to customers.

lia_vendor: Two options: 1) carrier re-uploads (no cost, ~24h). 2) DE re-ship from regional pool (adds 3 days transit + €2200 expedite + potential re-export docs). We can reserve 6 units in DE pool now and confirm in 2h to hold them.

marta_ops: Let's reserve 4 units from DE pool immediately to cover the critical reserved prod lanes. reserve 2 more for non-prod if cost acceptable. @shiv_procure you ok with the expedite budget? this will hit procurement contingency.

shiv_procure: approve reserve of 4 under expedited contingency. skip the extra 2 for now. please add cost code: PROC-EXP-2026. note: request documentation trail for audit.

james_sre: Ops note — when we swap in the standby A500s we need to rotate keys and purge KV caches to avoid token leakage across tenants. I'll add a runbook checklist.

marta_ops: good call. runbook: 1) tag units as "temp-reserve" in inventory, 2) apply host-level key rotation, 3) warm model cache with golden prompts, 4) monitor per-route latency and costs. I'll post the checklist in eng-oncall channel when done.

lia_vendor: Confirmed reservation of 4 A500 from DE pool. If FRA clears earlier we'll cancel re-ship and return units to pool (no charge). Will push AWB update once carrier re-uploads invoice.

shiv_procure: thanks. one more ask — can vendor include RMA swap reciprocity for 2 of the standby units (in case any arrive DOA)? need agreement in writing before shipping.

lia_vendor: yes, we'll include 2-unit swap clause. will email the PO amendment within the hour.

warehouse_bot: Action items logged: (1) reserve 4 A500 DE pool (procurement), (2) mark 2 FRA eval units as 'repurpose if needed' (ops), (3) lia_vendor to send PO amend + AWB update (vendor).

marta_ops: closing note — once units land, we'll run quick hardware smoke (30m) and then join live routing. tagging @james_sre for post-swap monitoring. :white_check_mark:

james_sre: on it. I'll schedule alerts for token-per-second and tail-latency regressions.

shiv_procure: perfect. thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for the handoff.
